source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 6 ноября ст. ст. — «Прп. Луки Тавроменийского (800-820).»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 6 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps, and the entry is the same man: Luke of Tauromenium in Sicily, whose parents wished to marry him and who refused. The same day's calendar keeps a second Luke, «ὁ ἐν Σπηλαίῳ», whom it calls Russian and gives no life; that is a separate entry and another man. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the page.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (25 September 2026).

death.note: The interval days.pravoslavie.ru prints at the end of its line for 6 ноября ст. ст., «Прп. Луки Тавроменийского (800-820).». The page does not say whether those are the years of his life, his abbacy or his death; its life page says only that he died at Corinth «в начале IX века», at the beginning of the ninth century, which the interval's upper end agrees with. Neither doxologia.ro nor saint.gr gave this folder any year, so this is the first date it carries.
